body:
After a share of a LSD drop at a festival one of the dancers living in Goa made me try smoking DMT and a few seconds later a dog crossing by transformed into a leopard!!! Everything around me shaped as Maya square shapes for 10 minutes.
The most incredible thing is that for a few hours all my wishes of contacting with people I would never be able to do came to reality. Like power of mind so strong that people I wanted to meet came spontaneously to me. That effect is still on since that experience!!!
In other terms it gave me confidence in me so strong that a second try is not necessary.
[DMT smoked joint]
